chain.title: The Blue-Leafed Tree
chain.desc: Runewood generates across the Overworld. Its planks build the Spirit Altar, the Totemic Staff and the Runic Workbench.

chain.title: Stone That Remembers
chain.desc: Soulstone Ore smelted down. Every single thing in Malum traces back through this one material.

chain.title: Quartz That Burns
chain.desc: Generates in the Nether and is also reaped from Nether mobs; the seed crystal for Ether.

chain.title: Gold From Below
chain.desc: Cthonic Gold Ore generates in the deeps. It is what turns a plain Impetus into a metal-specific one.

chain.title: Find the Weeping Well
chain.desc: Find a Weeping Well and inspect its pool and the Encyclopedia's instructions. Confirm this checkpoint after locating a usable well; you do not need to collect the pool as an inventory item.

chain.title: Open the Encyclopedia
chain.desc: Read the Encyclopedia Arcana before your first spirit infusion. Its diagrams and aspect lists explain the altar, totems and later workshop branches.

chain.title: The First Harvest
chain.desc: Use the Crude Scythe to reap Spirits from suitable creatures. Different creatures provide different aspects, so keep track of where you found the Spirits your next recipe needs.

chain.title: Spirit Infusion
chain.desc: Build the Spirit Altar and the supporting ingredient positions shown in the Encyclopedia. Prepare the main item, supporting materials and required Spirit aspects before beginning an infusion.

chain.title: Slate Without Properties
chain.desc: Soulstone given to the well. It is the base of Malignant Pewter and of the Void Tablet.

chain.title: Lead of the Black Crystal
chain.desc: Cthonic Gold given to the well, and the first item on the hidden black-crystal branch of the mod.

chain.title: Reap the First Soul
chain.desc: Collect an Arcane Spirit from a suitable reaping target. Keep the aspects separated; a pile of the wrong Spirit will not satisfy an infusion that asks for another kind.

chain.title: Stone Turned Sacred
chain.desc: Cobblestone infused with Sacred and Arcane. One half of the opposed pair every machine in the mod is built from.

chain.title: Stone Turned Wicked
chain.desc: The same infusion run with Wicked instead of Sacred. Tainted and Twisted pull against each other; that tension is the machine.

chain.title: The Crucible
chain.desc: Prepare the Spirit Crucible for focusing recipes. Unlike a single altar infusion, this machine works with an Impetus and a continuing Spirit supply, so keep the appropriate aspects available.

chain.title: A Light That Does Not Go Out
chain.desc: Glowstone dust infused with Infernal and Arcane. It burns in colours, lights the Catalyzer and never needs fuel.

chain.title: Clay, Rendered
chain.desc: Clay infused with Arcane, Earthen and Aqueous. The blank substrate under every augment and every Impetus.

chain.title: The Aspect That Gates Everything
chain.desc: Reap Eldritch Spirits from the creature sources listed in the Encyclopedia. This aspect opens advanced tablets and void-metal work, so prepare suitable combat equipment for its sources.

chain.title: The Book, Rewritten
chain.desc: Offer the Encyclopedia Arcana to the Weeping Well to obtain the Esoterica. Read its new entries before investing in the void materials and their more demanding Spirit recipes.

chain.title: Gunpowder, Cursed
chain.desc: Infuse gunpowder with a single Arcane Spirit. The cheapest infusion in the mod and an ingredient in half the rest.

chain.title: Gold Made Holy
chain.desc: Infuse gold with the required Spirit aspects to produce Hallowed Gold. It opens storage and equipment branches without requiring you to complete the Soulstained Steel weapon branch first.

chain.title: Soulstained Steel
chain.desc: Iron infused with three Wicked, one Earthen and one Arcane Spirit. The mod's weapon and armour metal.

chain.title: A Tablet of Eight Aspects
chain.desc: The first recipe that demands Aerial, Aqueous, Earthen, Infernal AND two Eldritch at once - the mod's real difficulty spike.

chain.title: Heat the Crucible
chain.desc: Place and supply Spirit Catalyzers in the arrangement described for your crucible. Measure whether the crucible speeds up before expanding the whole installation.

chain.title: Pewter, Malignant
chain.desc: Bring Malignant Lead, Null Slate and the required aspects together at the Spirit Altar. This alloy joins your void exploration with the established infusion workshop.

chain.title: Somewhere to Put Them
chain.desc: Organise your reaped aspects in Spirit Jars near the workshop. Check how your altar and crucible interact with the stored Spirits before depending on automatic supply.

chain.title: A Better Harvest
chain.desc: Upgrade your scythe using Soulstained Steel. Test its Spirit harvesting against familiar creatures; a better supply of aspects supports nearly every later experiment.

chain.title: Where Runes Are Cut
chain.desc: Set up the Runic Workbench and prepare the tablet and Spirits required by the rune you want. This equipment-customisation branch can grow alongside crucible processing.

chain.title: The Crucible's Heart
chain.desc: Prepare the Alchemical Impetus as the starting point for specialised focusing recipes. Choose the resource you want to process before committing it to a particular upgrade.

chain.title: Favor of the Void
chain.desc: Offer Hex Ash to the Weeping Well using the documented process. Retrieve the Void Salts and keep a supply for the void-tablet branch.

chain.title: The Central Pin
chain.desc: Fit a supported rune into a Runic Brooch and inspect the resulting effect. Choose a benefit for your current equipment instead of crafting every rune before using any of them.

chain.title: Spirit Focusing
chain.desc: Prepare a Copper Impetus and test its focusing recipe in the Spirit Crucible. Keep the required Spirit supply and output space available so the resource-processing branch can run consistently.

chain.title: Runes of the Void
chain.desc: Upgrade the tablet with Null Slate, Void Salts and the required Eldritch Spirits. Use the Esoterica to choose a supported late rune before spending the ingredients.

chain.title: The Last Scythe
chain.desc: Complete the Edge of Deliverance infusion using your Soulstained Steel Scythe, Malignant Pewter and the listed Spirits. The final weapon draws on both your original reaping setup and the void branch.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. Jar inspection verifies identifiers and selected mechanics, not that every route has been completed in game.

sources.scope: English guide/tooltip text, recipe data and inventory assets; selected special mechanics checked against implementation.

coverage.scope: Reaping, spirit infusion, runes, crucible processing and the Weeping Well/void-material branch.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
